coder_notes: Population includes recurrent IDHwt GBM and IDHm grade 4 astrocytoma in separate arms (mixed). Spironolactone is coded as a co-candidate (experimental_combination) because the record states an antitumour sensitisation hypothesis (TC-NER inhibition sensitizing GBM to STAR-001), not a delivery/exposure purpose. Moiety for STAR-001 uses the code first written in the record (LP-184 alias). IDH status defines the two cohorts (enrichment, not candidate-matched). PTGR1 is an exploratory tissue biomarker; the record does not state its link to STAR-001, so candidate_matched false (drug knowledge suggests PTGR1 activates LP-184). PK planned per title with sample type not stated (unclear); PTGR1 biomarker not explicitly linked to the candidate (target engagement unclear).
